question: Who became the first bowler in the history of T20 cricket to reach the milestone of 700 wickets?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rashid Khan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **On February 16, 2026, Afghanistan captain Rashid Khan became the first bowler to reach 700 wickets in T20 cricket history.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Landmark:** Rashid Khan achieved this historic feat during an **ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2026** group-stage match against the **United Arab Emirates (UAE)** at the **Arun Jaitley Stadium in Delhi**.
 
• **The 700th Wicket:** The milestone wicket was UAE's **Muhammad Arfan**, who was dismissed in a unique **hit-wicket** fashion while attempting a reverse sweep in the 16th over.
 
• **Efficiency:** Rashid reached the 700-wicket mark in just **513 innings**, maintaining a remarkable bowling average of approximately **18.51**.
 
• **Global Context:** He is well ahead of his closest competitors. Retired West Indies legend **Dwayne Bravo** sits second with 631 wickets, followed by **Sunil Narine** in third place with 613 wickets.
 
• **T20I Record:** In addition to his overall T20 tally (which includes franchise leagues like the IPL), Rashid remains the leading wicket-taker in **T20 Internationals (T20Is)** with over 190 wickets.
